steps.text: The production sea bakes registered real shores. Current-frame FFT waves and the depth field share the same metre scale.
The 12 m wave slopes refract a grid onto three depth planes. Area-ratio splats redistribute sunlight into the bright net on sand and rocks.
The water reads real opaque colour and depth in the existing pass. A once-baked late-morning sky cube, metered exposure and Neutral finish the image; classic home retains its cheaper sea.
